name: doable
description: A friendly, fast, offline-first task manager that syncs across web and Android.

scripts.test: node test/sync.test.js && node test/firestore.test.js && node test/moon.test.js && node test/contacts.test.js && node test/ics.test.js && node test/planner.test.js && node test/assistant.test.js && node test/freelance.test.js && node test/sharing.test.js && node test/issues.test.js && node test/timelog.test.js
scripts.sync:android: npm run vendor && cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.deploy:calendar: npm --prefix firebase/functions install && firebase deploy --only functions
